Change is coming to how local government works - share your views

One or two councils for Taranaki? This is your opportunity to get involved and have an early say on what is most important to you for the future of Local Government in Taranaki. The survey should take less than 5 minutes - click/tap here to tell us what you think.

News

  • Share your view on the future of Local Government in Taranaki

    12 Jun 2026, 3:06 pm

    ​Stratford District Council is inviting locals to share their views on the future of local government in Taranaki, with a community survey now open and running through to 12 July 2026.

  • Council agrees to take part in the Government’s Head Start pathway

    27 May 2026, 3:25 pm

    Stratford District Council has agreed to take part in the Government’s Head Start pathway for simplifying local government.

  • Annual Plan 2026/27 adopted

    26 May 2026, 4:04 pm

    ​Council has adopted its Annual Plan 2026/27, confirming the budget, work programme and rates for the coming financial year.

  • Councils given three months to propose the future of local government

    12 May 2026, 12:00 am

    Central Government told local councils to lead their own local government reform as part of the Government’s Head Start pathway, or wait for the Government to “do it to you.”
